name: China Development Bank Financial Leasing Co., Ltd.
summary: China Development Bank Financial Leasing Co., Ltd. engages in the leasing business in the People's Republic of China. It operates through the Aircraft Leasing, Ship Leasing, Energy Leasing, High-end Equipment Leasing, and Inclusive Finance segments. The Aircraft Leasing segment is involved in purchasing, leasing, management, and sale of commercial aircraft. The Ship Leasing segment engages in ship leasing business. The Energy Leasing segment is involved in energy leasing business. The High-end Equipment Leasing segment engages in high-end equipment leasing business.
